MENTOR PROSE (in an answer turn this is a slip; the learner sees only the answer): In Mentor Practice, Title moves on its own keyframes, and it also rides on CTRL, a null that's animated with keyframes. Title has 4 Position keys, 2 Scale keys and 2 Opacity keys, and none of them are hold keys. I'm assuming "land" means the moment Title's Position stops on its last key. CTRL's keys move Title too, but I didn't check which of CTRL's properties they're on or how far they move it.

1. **Unlock Title first.** Then select its last Position and Scale keyframes and choose Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Easy Ease In. *(Easing)*
2. **Make the slowdown longer.** Open the Graph Editor and switch to the Speed Graph. On Title's last Position key, drag the incoming handle further left so the slowdown lasts longer. *(Speed graph)*
3. **Check CTRL.** Select CTRL and press U to show its keyframes. If its last keys land at the same moment as Title's, apply Easy Ease In to them too. *(Easing)*
4. **Play it back** and watch the landing.
